name: Goon counter
description: Members press a button every time they gooned. ShifuBot counts it, shows the top 20 on Discord and the full list on a page for members.

defaults.title: Goon counter of {server}
defaults.description: Gooned? Press the button and your count goes up by one. Pressed it by accident? **Undo** takes it back for a few minutes.

panel.empty: Nobody has gooned yet. Be the first!
panel.failed: Settings saved, but the panel could not be updated: {error}
panel.help: Use this if someone deleted the panel message.

form.enabledHelp: ShifuBot posts a panel with the buttons in the channel below.
form.cooldownHelp: Minutes a member must wait between two presses. 0 turns it off.
form.undoWindowHelp: For this many minutes a member can take back a press. Only their own presses, and only as many as they made.
form.showLeaderboard: Show the top 20 and the server total
form.showLeaderboardHelp: The panel is updated at most every 15 seconds. The Full list button is always there.
form.title: Title
form.defaultHint: Leave empty to use the default text in the server language.

status.noChannel: Pick a channel for the panel.
status.channelMissing: The selected channel no longer exists. Choose another one.
status.missingPermissions: ShifuBot is missing permissions in this channel: {permissions}.
status.panelMissing: The panel is not posted yet. Save, or post it again below.
status.total: {count} goons on this server so far

top.title: Top 20
top.openListHelp: Every member of the server can open it after signing in with Discord.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.hint: The panel exactly as Discord will show it, with the current numbers.

list.title: Goon counter
list.notOnList: You are not on the list yet. Press the button on the panel in Discord to get on it.
list.empty: Nobody has gooned yet. Be the first!
list.signInBody: Sign in with Discord to see the full goon list of this server. Only members of the server can see it.
list.notMemberBody: You are signed in, but not as a member of this server. Only its members can see this list.
list.notFoundBody: This list does not exist, or the goon counter is turned off on this server.

setup.title: Goon counter
setup.description: A button members press every time they gooned, with a top 20 on Discord and the full list on a member page. Fine tune it later on the Goon counter page.
setup.channelRequired: Pick a channel, or turn the goon counter off for now.

replies.disabled: The goon counter is turned off on this server.
replies.counted: Counted! You are at **{count}**. Pressed it by accident? **Undo** works until {time}.
replies.cooldown: Easy there. You can count the next one {time}.
replies.undone: Taken back. You are at **{count}** now.
replies.nothingToUndo: Nothing to undo. Only presses from the last {minutes} minutes can be taken back.

errors.missing_permissions: missing permissions in the panel channel
